prompt: What is Equinox and When Does It Occur? The sun falls directly on the equator two times in a year. During this period there is equal length of day and night all over the world. In Northern Hemisphere, the March Equinox is called the Vernal or Spring Equinox while September Equinox is called Autumnal Equinox. Spring Equinox (March 21st) marks the beginning of spring. Autumn Equinox (September 23rd) marks the beginning of autumn.
